title: I Killed an Academy Player
altTitles: I Killed the Player of the Academy
ไอ้เพลเยอร์นั่น ฉันฆ่ามันเอง
アカデミーの主人公を殺した
Ta Đã Giết Một Người Chơi Trong Học Viện
description: Corin is transported into his favorite game as a minor NPC. Fortunately, he knows the game inside and out, and he initially plans to use his knowledge to survive alongside Sihu, the game's main player. But when Corin discovers that Sihu has been murdering innocent NPCs and stealing their items, he realizes that the supposed hero is actually a monster. After Sihu mysteriously fails the final mission, Corin is sent three years into the past. Determined to stop Sihu, Corin decides to kill the main player, take his place, defeat the final boss, and save the world.
author: Salamsallyeo
